history.origins: Trix (also spelled Trex or Ticks) is a compendium card game popular across the Levant and Gulf, including Jordan, Kuwait, Lebanon, Palestine, Saudi Arabia, Syria and the United Arab Emirates. English-language rules were first documented from contributors in the region (Suad Harms, V M and others) in 2007. The game combines four trick-avoidance contracts with a fifth shedding contract similar to Fan Tan.

rules.objective: Score points or avoid penalties across 20 deals (four kingdoms of five contracts each). The player with the highest total score after all deals wins.
rules.gameplay: Kingdom owner picks 1 of 5 contracts. Contracts: 1) Kâ™¥ = -75. 2) Queens = -25 each. 3) Diamonds = -10 each. 4) Tricks = -15 each. 5) Trix (shedding from Jacks up/down) = +200/+150/+100/+50.

strategy.basic: Pick easiest contracts first. Dump penalty cards.
strategy.intermediate: Order contracts based on hand strength.
strategy.advanced: Double opponents' penalty cards. Control trick-taking.
